subject.title: [Bug]: Skill Workshop agent-tool apply times out because approval wait exceeds tool watchdog

question: Should this issue be resolved by landing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91325's bounded 150s Codex `skill_workshop` watchdog change, or should maintainers hold it for a broader Skill Workshop approval-timeout design?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the available fix changes how long a Codex dynamic-tool call can occupy the run while waiting for an approval decision on a security-sensitive lifecycle action.

options.title: Land the bounded watchdog fix
options.body: Accept the focused 150s `skill_workshop` Codex watchdog so the existing 120s approval window can resolve without a generic 90s timeout.

options.title: Require live prompt proof first
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until a maintainer or contributor proves the full Gateway plus Codex approval prompt path in a real session.

options.title: Hold for broader approval design
options.body: Pause the narrow PR and resolve this only after deciding the larger Skill Workshop approval TTL, metadata, and channel-owner evidence model.

recommendation.title: Land the bounded watchdog fix
recommendation.body: Accept the focused 150s `skill_workshop` Codex watchdog so the existing 120s approval window can resolve without a generic 90s timeout.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and has recent history on the affected Codex app-server dynamic-tool path.
